title: Find and remove what triggers CSP script-src eval reports on /people/<handle> and /create-a-space

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: SCAN-1032 detail: csp.violation script-src eval reported on /people/<handle> and /create-a-space. Checked 2026-11-16: UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET IS set in Vercel production (earlier suspicion cleared).

WHY IT MATTERS: An eval call may hide a dependency that needs unsafe-eval; it blocks tightening the CSP (see SCAN-1243).

FIX DIRECTION: Trace the eval source from the csp-report samples, replace or isolate it, record the finding in docs/security/csp-eval-trace.md.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
